summary: Phase 10E-4 frontend validation completed. PART A (Supplier BankAccountsDialog) and PART B (Booking search + booking-number badge + status filter) both work end-to-end for Super Admin. All 15 sub-flows requested by main agent were exercised via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and passed.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' (a11y). Non-blocking but should be fixed for a11y compliance across dialogs.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent for supplier dialog and BankAccountsDialog to silence the accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Suppliers.jsx: BankAccountsDialog correctly disables 'Set Primary' when already primary and only renders one 'Set Primary' button when needed — verified UI (only 1 set-primary button visible when 2 accounts and one is primary).
Bookings.jsx: debounced (350ms) search + status filter combined properly via query params (search + status). Clear button resets search only, status persists — matches spec.
Booking row uses onClick navigation on the whole card; the search-clear <button> is nested inside a card-less region so no click bubbling issue. Good.
Duplicate account_number rejection returns backend-provided 409 detail 'Nomor rekening sudah ada untuk supplier ini' — surfaced correctly via toast.
seed_data_creation: Created and then archived supplier TEST_Supplier_1787127370 (id 6a85664ba37fd23e6fb396ad) — cleaned up via DELETE /api/suppliers/{id}?reason=cleanup+test+data (HTTP 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Detailed observations from this run:
PART A — Supplier Bank Accounts:
  * Auto-primary on first added account (BCA) — verified.
  * Second account (Mandiri, #789012) added — 2 rows, primary stayed on BCA.
  * Duplicate account_number '123456' → HTTP 409, no new row, toast: 'Nomor rekening sudah ada untuk supplier ini'.
  * Blank Nama Pemilik → client-side validation toast 'Nama bank, pemilik, dan nomor rekening wajib diisi', no save.
  * Set Primary on Mandiri → single primary now on Mandiri (verified via bank-row containing 'Primary').
  * Edit Mandiri bank_name → 'Mandiri Syariah' — row updated.
  * Delete primary (Mandiri Syariah is now not-primary after edit? Actually after set-primary Mandiri became primary; deleting it auto-promoted remaining account) — 1 row left, still exactly one Primary badge; Supplier table 'Bank Utama' column reflected remaining primary.

PART B — Bookings /booking:
  * Placeholder exact match: 'Cari nomor booking, nama customer, nomor HP, atau email...'.
  * 16 bookings load initially, all rows expose data-testid=booking-number-<id> as prominent blue Badge (font-mono).
  * 'BKG-00015' → 1 row (badge BKG-00015). 'bkg-00015' lowercase → 1 row (case-insensitive confirmed).
  * 'Budi Santoso' → 11 rows (matches expected ~11).
  * 'budi.s@gmail.com' → 11 rows (email resolution via customers collection working).
  * '9999 0000' phone fragment → 11 rows (whitespace-tolerant fragment search working).
  * Status filter CONFIRMED → 14 rows; combined with 'Budi Santoso' → 9 rows.
  * booking-search-clear restores full list (16).
  * 'Semua Status' shows all statuses.

Minor a11y console warning (Radix DialogContent missing description) — non-blocking.
